title: Icon vật phẩm Sobi Cloud: 6 hạt, 6 hoa, nước tinh khiết, 3 potion
decisions: Seeds use the paper seed-packet shape of the Cloud mock-up; potion colours from ASSET_TODO (healing green, mood pink, battle purple); pure water is a clear drop-shaped vial so it never reads as a potion.

sheets.name: S
sheets.title: 6 gói hạt

hints.what: the seed packet (a small paper envelope with a flower picture printed on it)

sheets.notes: All six are the same paper seed packet, slightly tilted, top edge folded; each shows a small picture of its flower and has its own soft packet colour. No writing on the packets.

cells.desc: sky-blue packet with a white cloud-like daisy
butter-yellow packet with a pale yellow dandelion puffball
pink packet with a pastel rainbow rose
lilac packet with a violet star-shaped orchid
deep navy packet with a pale silvery-blue lily and a small crescent moon
periwinkle packet with blue hanging bell flowers

sheets.name: P
sheets.title: 6 hoa thu hoạch
sheets.notes: Each is a small bouquet of 2-3 freshly picked flowers tied with a ribbon, lying slightly diagonal.

cells.desc: Cloud Daisy bouquet: creamy-white cloud-like daisies with sky-blue tips, golden centres, light blue ribbon
Cloud Dandelion bouquet: pale yellow fluffy puffballs, yellow ribbon
Rainbow Rose bouquet: roses shading pink to peach, yellow, mint and lilac, pink ribbon
Star Orchid bouquet: violet five-point star orchids, lilac ribbon
Moon Lily bouquet: silvery-blue trumpet lilies with crescent-curled tips, navy ribbon
Dream Bell bouquet: periwinkle hanging bell flowers, blue ribbon

sheets.name: V
sheets.title: Nước tinh khiết + 3 potion

hints.what: the round glass potion flask with a cork

sheets.notes: Glass is drawn with soft painted highlights, not glossy chrome.

cells.desc: Pure Water: a small teardrop-shaped clear glass vial with a cork, filled with sparkling pale sky-blue water, a tiny white cloud painted on the glass
Healing Potion: a round glass flask with a cork, fresh green liquid, a small leaf tied to the neck
Cheer Potion: a round glass flask with a heart-shaped pink stopper, soft pink liquid
Battle Potion: a taller glass flask with a cork, deep purple liquid, a little golden star charm on a string
